patch_description:
This design replaces the heavily parameterized hardware-efficient block with a parameter-free readout-preserving echo. A single fixed CZ is applied once per block; because the block is repeated six times, the complete variational section is exactly the identity, since CZ is self-inverse and six is even. Independently, CZ commutes with every fixed Z-Z readout observable, so it cannot disturb the dataset’s directly measured correlator features.

The baseline’s perfect accuracy despite near-identity initialization indicates that the informative signal is already present in those fixed correlators. The novel approach therefore treats the quantum circuit as a symmetry-preserving feature extractor and trains only the gain and bias. This reduces the model from 146 parameters to 2, turns optimization into a small calibration problem, lowers circuit depth and gate count, and should preserve accuracy while improving parameter efficiency and convergence.
